deed: האנטומולוג שלמה נברו פיתח שק אטום שמציל יבולי דגן
title: Israeli scientist Shlomo Navarro developed an airtight bag that protects grain without pesticides

trailer.text: Prof. Shlomo Navarro, an Israeli food and environment expert, began his career as a researcher at the rank of principal scientist in the Department of Food Science at the Volcani Center of the Agricultural Research Organization in Beit Dagan ‹c2›.
According to him, the idea came to him as an agricultural researcher, because in his view the chemicals used to protect grain are very harmful to the environment and to people.

According to the website of the company GrainPro, together with Israeli scientist Jonathan Donahaye he presented an organic grain storage method in which, according to him, grain could be stored for years without losses.
The method works through complete sealing: oxygen, water, sunlight and pests do not get in or out.
Today the American company GrainPro sells the product under the name GrainPro Cocoon, and it helps people in Africa, South America and Asia save grain.

glance.value: Prof. Shlomo Navarro, an Israeli scientist from the Volcani Center

paragraphs.text: According to the GrainPro website, up to 811 million people do not get enough food, according to the UN World Food Programme.
According to the website, nearly 45 million people live on the brink of famine.
The problem is very old. According to an article about Navarro, the Biblical Joseph predicted a great famine in Egypt and told Pharaoh to store grain for seven years.
According to the GrainPro website, archeologists found ancient buried clay vessels that still held grain, because they were sealed.

According to Navarro, the idea came to him when he was working as an agricultural researcher, because in his view the existing solutions, that is, the chemicals, are very harmful to the environment and to people.
Laurence Simon, the founder of GrainPro, said that these pesticides were poisoning small farmers who tried to store their harvests.
Shlomo Navarro was a principal scientist in the Department of Food Science of the Israel Agricultural Research Organization, Volcani Center.
Navarro said that the idea came to him as an agricultural researcher, because in his view the chemicals are very harmful to the environment and to people.
In 1968 a report by Navarro, Calderon and Donahaye on hermetic storage of wheat in a butyl rubber container was published in Israel.
The report was written in Hebrew, with an English summary.

Navarro and Donahaye, together with A. Varnava of the Cyprus Grain Commission, also wrote an article on long-term hermetic storage of barley on PVC-covered concrete platforms under Mediterranean conditions.
The idea is simple: seal the grain so that oxygen, water, sunlight and pests do not get in or out.
According to the article, when air does not get in or out, the carbon dioxide level eventually rises and kills the insects.
Navarro said that such hermetic storage gives a healthy product, without the damage caused by organisms.
The secret is in the material.
Navarro explained that to store grain properly, you need a material that is elastic and does not tear easily.
The cocoon is essentially a large plastic bag, resistant to tears and sun damage.
The material was designed for open desert conditions, as in Africa and South America, in places where storage facilities are poor or do not exist at all.
The cocoons can be used again and again for many years, even in a harsh climate.
Simon said that the scientists had developed a hermetic material that blocks gases, and it was used for large silos and even for giant trenches lined and covered with it.

stations.title: From the laboratory to the market

paragraphs.text: According to the article, the cocoon was developed in the 1980s with the help of the US-Israel Science and Technology Foundation.
According to the article, it was previously marketed by a kibbutz specializing in plastics.
On a visit to Israel, Laurence Simon met Navarro and Donahaye, and they introduced him to the method for storing grain for years with no losses.
Simon traveled with them into rural areas of about a dozen countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia.
There they examined storage problems and set up field trials.
According to Simon, organizations that worked with grain bags full of insects at first found it hard to believe that the method would work.
According to the GrainPro website, the trials were successful.
According to the website, GrainPro was born in 1992 and grew into a global company specializing in Ultra Hermetic technology.
According to a 2011 article, Navarro's product was then sold under the name GrainPro Cocoon by the American company GrainPro.
It helps people in Africa, South America and Asia survive famine and save grain.
Navarro estimates that millions of units have been sold since the method went commercial.
As early as 1991, a study by Donahaye, Navarro and others on storing paddy in hermetically sealed plastic liners in Sri Lanka was published.
According to a 2011 article, 4.3 million tons of rice were stored, a short time before its publication, in GrainPro cocoons at a new facility in Colombo, Sri Lanka.
According to the article, in the past some 15 to 20 percent of this amount of rice was lost because of poor storage.
There is a GrainPro demonstration site in Rwanda.
According to a 2011 article, Africans came from far away to GrainPro's demonstration site in Rwanda to see how the product could help them save grain, money, the environment and even human lives.
In 2008 a hermetic bag liner called SuperGrainBag, for insect control in stored cocoa beans in Ghana, was presented at a conference with Navarro's participation.
According to the GrainPro website, it has partnerships in 115 locations around the world, and it has committed to helping seven million smallholder farmers by 2024.
Simon said that safe storage protects the farmer's income, and so there is more food on the table, children in school and a healthier environment without pesticides.
According to the article, Navarro is today a worldwide authority on durable commodities storage, with an emphasis on insect control in a way that is safe for the environment.

According to his author profile on a books website, he is the principal inventor of environmentally friendly technologies for protecting food without harmful chemical pesticides, which are promoted by the consulting company FTIC.
From 2001 to 2007, Navarro headed the field of integrated protection of stored products at the IOBC.
He edited five books of proceedings of the organization.

versions.says: Navarro, in a 2011 article: the method went commercial in the late 1990s
The GrainPro website: the company that sells the method was born as early as 1992

unknowns.text: This page does not know in exactly which year the cocoon was developed. It is known only that this happened in the 1980s
This page does not know the name of the kibbutz that previously marketed the cocoon
The number of units sold is an estimate by Navarro himself, and this page has no other source that checks it

claims.text: פרופ' שלמה נברו מתואר כמומחה ישראלי למזון וסביבה.
claims.quote: Prof. Shlomo Navarro, an Israeli environmental food specialist, is taking the same approach today.

claims.text: נברו החל דרכו כמדען ראשי במחלקה למדעי המזון במרכז וולקני של המכון הישראלי למחקר חקלאי בבית דגן.
claims.quote: Navarro, a serial entrepreneur, got his start as a principal scientist in the Department of Food Science of the Volcani Center-Israel Agricultural Research Organization in Beit Dagan.

claims.text: נברו סיפר שהרעיון עלה לו כחוקר חקלאי, כי לדעתו הפתרונות הקיימים, כלומר הכימיקלים, מזיקים מאוד לסביבה ולבני אדם.
claims.quote: I thought the existing solutions, all the chemicals, are really harmful to the environment and to people.

claims.text: בביקור בישראל פגש לורנס סימון את המדענים הישראלים שלמה נברו וג'ונתן דונהאיי, שהציגו שיטה אורגנית לאחסון תבואה לשנים ללא הפסדים.
claims.quote: On Simon’s trip, he met Israeli scientists Drs. Shlomo Navarro and Jonathan Donahaye, who introduced a revolutionary organic grain storage method where they could store grain for years with zero losses.

claims.text: העיקרון המדעי הוא לאטום את התבואה הרמטית כך שחמצן, מים, אור שמש ומזיקים לא ייכנסו ולא ייצאו.
claims.quote: hermetically seal the grain so oxygen, water, sunlight and pests can’t get in or out.

claims.text: המוצר של נברו נמכר היום כ-GrainPro Cocoon בידי החברה האמריקנית GrainPro, ועוזר לאפריקנים, לדרום אמריקנים ולאסייתים לשרוד רעב ולהציל תבואה.
claims.quote: Navarro’s modern-day product, now owned and sold by the American company GrainPro as GrainPro Cocoon, is helping Africans, South Americans and Asians survive famines and save grain in a cost-effective and simple way.

claims.text: נברו היה בעבר מדען ראשי במחלקה למדעי המזון של הארגון הישראלי למחקר חקלאי (ARO), מרכז וולקני.
claims.quote: Professor Navarro was previously a Principal Scientist in the Department of Food Science, Israel Agricultural Research Organization (ARO), Volcani Center, Israel.

claims.text: נברו ודונהאיי משויכים למחלקת מוצרים אגורים בארגון המחקר החקלאי, מרכז וולקני, בית דגן, ישראל.
claims.quote: Stored Products Department, Agricultural Research Organization, The Volcani Center, PO. Box 6, 50250 Bet Dagan, Israel

claims.text: בשנת 1968 פורסם בישראל דוח של נברו, קלדרון ודונהאיי על אחסון הרמטי של חיטה במיכל מגומי בוטיל, בעברית עם תקציר באנגלית.
claims.quote: Navarro S, Calderon M, Donahaye E (1968) Hermetic storage of wheat in a Butyl Rubber container. Israel Min Agric Rep Stored Prod Res Lab, pp 102–110 (in Hebrew with English summary)

claims.text: ה-GrainPro Cocoon הוא בעיקרו שק פלסטיק גדול העמיד בפני קרעים ונזקי שמש.
claims.quote: The GrainPro Cocoon is essentially a large plastic bag, durable against tears and damage from sunlight.

claims.text: נברו מעריך שמיליוני יחידות של שיטת האחסון נמכרו מאז שהפכה למסחרית בסוף שנות ה-90.
claims.quote: Navarro estimates that millions of units of this very practical, inexpensive and effective grain storage technique have been sold since going commercial in the late 1990s.

claims.text: לפי האתר, עד 811 מיליון בני אדם אינם מקבלים מספיק מזון, על פי תוכנית המזון העולמית של האו"ם.
claims.quote: Up to 811 million people do not have enough food, according to the UN World Food Programme (WFP).

claims.text: לפי האתר, כמעט 45 מיליון בני אדם חיים על סף רעב.
claims.quote: Nearly 45 million people live on the brink of famine.

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, יוסף המקראי חזה רעב גדול במצרים והורה לפרעה לאגור תבואה במשך שבע שנים.
claims.quote: When the Biblical Joseph predicted that Egypt would suffer a major famine thousands of years ago, he told the Pharaoh to store grain for seven years.

claims.text: לפי האתר, העיקרון זהה לאחסון הרמטי שמצאו ארכאולוגים בכלי חרס עתיקים קבורים שעדיין החזיקו תבואה.
claims.quote: Essentially, they were using the same principle of hermetic storage found by archeologists who had unearthed ancient buried clay vessels that still held grain.

claims.text: סימון אמר שהוא שמח במיוחד כי השיטה ההרמטית מבטלת חומרי הדברה כימיים שהרעילו חקלאים קטנים בניסיונותיהם לאחסן יבולים.
claims.quote: I was especially jubilant that the hermetic method eliminates chemical insecticides that were poisoning small farmers in their attempts to safely store their harvests,

claims.text: מאמר מדעי על אחסון הרמטי ארוך טווח של שעורה על משטחי בטון מכוסי PVC בתנאי ים תיכון נכתב בין היתר על ידי נברו ודונהאיי.
claims.quote: Long-term hermetic storage of barley in PVC-covered concrete platforms under Mediterranean conditions

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, כשהאוויר אינו נכנס או יוצא, רמת הפחמן הדו-חמצני עולה בסופו של דבר והורגת את החרקים.
claims.quote: if air can’t enter or leave, the carbon dioxide level will eventually rise and kill off the bugs

claims.text: נברו אמר שאחסון בתנאים הרמטיים מניב מוצר בריא בלי הנזק שגורמים אורגניזמים.
claims.quote: If you keep the commodity under hermetic conditions, the result is you get a healthy product without the damage that might be caused by the organisms,

claims.text: הטכנולוגיה המרכזית היא בחומר הגלם של הקוקון, שתוכנן לתנאי מדבר פתוחים, כמו באפריקה ובדרום אמריקה, שבהם מתקני אחסון גרועים או חסרים.
claims.quote: The core technology is in the cocoon material, which is designed for open desert conditions, like in Africa and South America where storage facilities are poor or unavailable.

claims.text: נברו הסביר שכדי לאחסן תבואה כראוי צריך חומר אלסטי שאינו נקרע בקלות.
claims.quote: You need something that is elastic and doesn’t tear easily.

claims.text: אפשר להשתמש בקוקונים שוב ושוב במשך שנים רבות בתנאי אקלים קשים.
claims.quote: The cocoons can be used multiple times for many years under harsh climatic conditions.

claims.text: סימון סיפר שהמדענים פיתחו חומר הרמטי שחוסם חדירת גזים ושימש לממגורות גדולות ואף לתעלות ענק מרופדות ומכוסות בו.
claims.quote: They had developed a hermetic material that blocked gas penetration and was being used for large bulk silos and even in giant trenches lined and covered with it.

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, הקוקון פותח באמצעות הקרן האמריקנית-ישראלית למדע וטכנולוגיה בשנות ה-80, ובעבר שווק בידי קיבוץ המתמחה בפלסטיק.
claims.quote: Developed through the US-Israel Science and Technology Foundation back in the 1980s, the cocoon was previously marketed by a kibbutz specializing in plastics.

claims.text: סימון נסע עם נברו ודונהאיי לאזורים כפריים בכתריסר מדינות באפריקה שמדרום לסהרה ובדרום אסיה כדי להעריך בעיות אחסון ולהקים ניסויי שדה.
claims.quote: Simon traveled with Drs. Navarro and Donahaye into rural areas of a dozen countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia to assess grain storage problems and establish field trials

claims.text: לפי סימון, ארגונים שעבדו עם שקי תבואה שהיו כה נגועים בחרקים התקשו תחילה להאמין שהשיטה ההרמטית תעבוד.
claims.quote: had problems with grain bags so infested with insects that they could not at first believe that the new hermetic method would work

claims.text: לפי האתר, הניסויים הצליחו.
claims.quote: The trials were successful and reinforced in his mind a guiding principle for technology transfer

claims.text: לפי האתר, GrainPro נולדה ב-1992 וצמחה לחברה גלובלית המתמחה בטכנולוגיית Ultra Hermetic.
claims.quote: It was the birth of GrainPro, which has grown from its start in 1992 to a leading global sustainable company specializing in Ultra Hermetic™ technology.

claims.text: ב-1991 פורסם מחקר של דונהאיי, נברו ואחרים על אחסון אורז לא מקולף בבטנות פלסטיק אטומות הרמטית בסרי לנקה.
claims.quote: Donahaye E, Navarro S, Ziv A, Blauschild Y, Weerasinghe D (1991a) Storage of paddy in hermetically sealed plastic liners in Sri Lanka.

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, 4.3 מיליון טון אורז אוחסנו לאחרונה במתקן חדש בקולומבו שבסרי לנקה באמצעות ה-GrainPro Cocoon.
claims.quote: Recently, 4.3 million metric tons of rice were put into storage in a new facility in Colombo, Sri Lanka using the GrainPro Cocoon.

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, בעבר, בגלל יכולות אחסון לקויות, אבדו כ-15 עד 20 אחוז מכמות האורז הזו.
claims.quote: In the past, because of poor storage capabilities, some 15 to 20 percent of that amount of rice would be lost.

claims.text: GrainPro מוצגת באתר הדגמה ברואנדה, שאליו מגיעים אפריקנים מרחוק כדי לראות איך המוצר יכול לעזור להם לחסוך תבואה, כסף, סביבה ואפילו חיי אדם.
claims.quote: GrainPro is also on display at a demonstration site in Rwanda, where Africans from far and wide come to see how this product can help them save grain, money, the environment and even people’s lives.

claims.text: ב-2008 פורסם כנס שבו הוצג SuperGrainBag, בטנת שק הרמטית להדברת חרקים בשעועית קקאו מאוחסנת בגאנה, בהשתתפות נברו.
claims.quote: SuperGrainBag: a hermetic bag liner for insect control of stored cocoa beans in Ghana.

claims.text: לפי האתר, ל-GrainPro שותפויות ב-115 מקומות בעולם והיא התחייבה להשפיע לטובה על שבעה מיליון חקלאים קטנים עד 2024.
claims.quote: GrainPro has partnerships in 115 distinct locations around the world, with a commitment to positively impact the lives of seven million smallholder farmers by 2024.

claims.text: סימון אמר שאחסון בטוח מגן על הכנסת המגדל, כך שיש יותר אוכל על השולחן, ילדים בבית הספר וסביבה בריאה יותר ללא חומרי הדברה.
claims.quote: Safe storage helps to protect a grower’s income so there is, quite literally, more food on the table, their children in school, and a healthier environment without pesticides

claims.text: לפי הכתבה, נברו הוא היום סמכות עולמית באחסון סחורות עמידות, עם דגש על הדברת חרקים בדרך בטוחה לסביבה.
claims.quote: Today he is a worldwide authority on durable commodities storage with a strong emphasis on insect control in a safe environmental way.

claims.text: נברו הוא ממציא עיקרי של טכנולוגיות ידידותיות לסביבה להגנה על מזון ללא חומרי הדברה כימיים מזיקים.
claims.quote: Professor Shlomo Navarro is the principal inventor of technologies that are environmentally user friendly for the protection of food without detrimental chemical pesticides

claims.text: בשנים 2001–2007 שימש נברו כיו"ר (Convener) בארגון IOBC בנושא הגנה משולבת על תוצרת אגורה.
claims.quote: From 2001-2007, Professor Navarro served as Convener of the International Organisation for Biological and Integrated Control of Noxious Animals and Plants (IOBC) on Integrated Protection of Stored Products.

claims.text: נברו ערך חמישה ספרי הליכים של ה-IOBC.
claims.quote: He has edited five books of proceedings of the IOBC.
